settings.title: Display settings
settings.intro: Row spacing and the language this plugin draws in. Language changes apply immediately; row spacing applies when you save.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Automatic follows Paseo's app language. A choice here overrides it for this plugin's own screens.

rowMarginY.label: Extra spacing between rows
rowMarginY.hint: Added on top of the host's fixed 16px for tool rows and the streaming thinking row. Negative values are allowed: 8 → about 24px, -8 → about 8px, -16 → about 0px. Range -16 to 24.

toolRowPaddingY.label: Tool row vertical padding (inside the row)
toolRowPaddingY.hint: Changes only the padding inside a row, not the gap between rows. To tighten the gap, edit “Extra spacing between rows” above. Range 0 to 12.

toolRowMinHeight.label: Tool row minimum height
toolRowMinHeight.hint: How tall a row is at minimum; with padding 0 it can shrink to about the icon height (about 17px). Range 12 to 64.

toolRowGap.label: Horizontal gap between icon and text
toolRowGap.hint: Between the icon, the verb and the target. Range 0 to 24.

commandMaxHeightRatio.label: Command block maximum height (share of the window)
commandMaxHeightRatio.hint: 0.25 means at most a quarter of the window height; beyond that the command block scrolls internally and the output area stays visible. Range 0.1 to 0.6.

commandMinHeight.label: Command block minimum height cap
commandMinHeight.hint: The height the command block keeps even in a very small window, in pixels. Range 60 to 360.
